root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `loadProjection()` appends another `MS_STRING` or `MS_AUTO` token into `p->args[i]`, it must enforce `i < MS_MAXPROJARGS`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable parser reaches the append site with `i == MS_MAXPROJARGS` and still executes `p->args[i] = msStrdup(msyystring_buffer)`. The fixed program inserts the missing full-array rejection at this site, so the original crashing case becomes guarded while the adjacent 20-argument boundary case still executes the append with `i == 19`.

nodes.state: At the crashing `p->args[i] = msStrdup(msyystring_buffer)` store, `i == MS_MAXPROJARGS`, so the write targets the first slot beyond the 20-entry `p->args` array.

edges.relation: The same local index `i` observed at the missing-guard decision is the index used immediately afterward by the `p->args[i]` sink store.
